scope: Historical audit of the development checkout before its promotion to main. Scores and release blockers describe that checkout at audit time.
testQualityVerdict: Useful unit-level checks, insufficient evidence for end-to-end or release readiness. The original complete suite missed reproducible dishonest scorecards.

findings.title: A failed test could become proven by editing only its current status
findings.reproduction: Re-read the real committed pack through checkProject after changing c3 to proven and the current result to passed; original code accepted it.
findings.fix: Compare current and historical statuses with sealed results.

findings.title: Missing or unreferenced evidence could still yield a verified scorecard
findings.reproduction: Delete the committed pack or remove its run record while leaving green claims; original report accepted it.
findings.fix: Require an in-project pack, hash and matching run provenance.

findings.title: Assertion counts were trusted from JSON
findings.reproduction: Set a real passing flow to 999 assertions; original checker accepted it.
findings.fix: Recount assertions from result.yaml and compare current/history counts.

findings.title: An old green result survived a newer failed-to-start attempt
findings.reproduction: Append a newer infrastructure-error attempt for a proven flow; original checker accepted the stale claim.
findings.fix: Latest attempted run must support the claimed status.

findings.title: Skipped, interrupted and runner-broken results could condemn the product
findings.reproduction: Mark a broken claim with a skipped/interrupted/no-steps/unknown result; original checker accepted it.
findings.fix: Only an actual failed test can support a broken-product claim; label runner failures blocked.

findings.title: A partial runner response could pass the gate
findings.reproduction: Launch the bundled CLI against a child process that completes only one of two requested flows.
findings.fix: Require completed results for every requested member and a completed successful stream.

findings.title: A typo or --only subset could silently narrow a gate
findings.reproduction: Select a valid flow plus a typo, or select one flow with --gate.
findings.fix: Reject missing selections before running; a gate covers every active flow.

findings.title: Malformed scan/results could erase coverage or crash the checker
findings.reproduction: Feed null flow data or a version-only scan; original accepted it or threw.
findings.fix: Validate data shape and return actionable invalid-input errors.

findings.title: Corrupt results silently reset run history
findings.reproduction: Existing loadResults caught parse errors and returned an empty history.
findings.fix: Stop before invoking Kane; preserve the file and require restoration.

findings.title: Concurrent runs could overwrite ownership and lose history
findings.reproduction: The old marker was overwritten and released before policy/evidence persistence.
findings.fix: Exclusive marker creation around the complete read-run-evaluate-write transaction.

findings.title: A rolling history could forget the original failure
findings.reproduction: After more than 30 retries, the original strict failure anchor was discarded.
findings.fix: Retain the full history; a native runner crash cannot anchor a product fix.

findings.title: The advertised invariant on unchanged checks was not enforced
findings.reproduction: checksSha was recorded and displayed but a weakened latest check could still be proven.
findings.fix: Compare latest checks to the original checks; require restoration or an unverifiable verdict.

findings.title: Sharing left URL credentials and response bodies in HAR logs
findings.reproduction: Add credentials to URL userinfo, token query metadata, a response body and redirect URL.
findings.fix: Scrub those fields while retaining endpoint/status evidence; explicitly require screenshot review.

findings.title: Unrelated policy output could be mistaken for the claims verdict
findings.reproduction: The policy parser fell back to the first policy; gate checks accepted empty gate lists.
findings.fix: Require the intended policy and every required blocking gate.

findings.title: A judge could withdraw a failed claim
findings.reproduction: withdraw did not check the scan mode despite being documented as pre-flight only.
findings.fix: Refuse unless a valid scan records preflight mode.

findings.title: Shared withdrawals had no after-README to verify
findings.reproduction: The original share copy omitted the builder README; an offline reader could not check withdrawal.
findings.fix: Include and check a scrubbed README.after.md snapshot; preserve it when re-sharing.

findings.title: Duplicate claim ids and nested flow names were mishandled
findings.reproduction: Case-duplicate ids were accepted; report lookup dropped subfolders; Kane merges duplicate basenames.
findings.fix: Reject duplicate ids/basenames and preserve nested flow paths.

findings.title: The mobile demo and scorecard overflowed the viewport
findings.reproduction: Real Chrome at 390px measured widths greater than the viewport.
findings.fix: Constrain grid minimums and scroll coverage/run tables within their containers.

findings.title: Release claims and submission notes were stale
findings.reproduction: README advertised an undeployed Pages site; template said 2/4 for a 3/5 run; deadline still said Nov 19.
findings.fix: Use local v0.3 instructions, refresh report assets/counts and correct the extended Nov 26 deadline.

findings.title: The video did not compile or register its demo
findings.reproduction: Missing data module and every Kane image; composition not registered; panel height calculation 100x too large.
findings.fix: Generate data/crops from real evidence, register the composition, fix dimensions/image loading, render and inspect an H.264/AAC film.

findings.title: There was no packaged-install or CLI process verification
findings.reproduction: The original suite never launched the CLI/Kane process boundary.
findings.fix: Add clean npm-tarball execution, CLI subprocess contracts, targeted mutations and a CI definition.

findings.title: Absent README extraction was not disclosed in the headline
findings.reproduction: Without a use-case list, listed-claim counts could be read as full README coverage.
findings.fix: Show an explicit coverage warning in HTML and Markdown.

remaining.title: Repository remains private and default branch remains v0.2
remaining.action: Review and publish the v0.3 changes, then make the submission repository public. No publication was performed by this audit.

remaining.title: YouTube and two public-post URLs remain unconfirmed
remaining.action: Upload the finished film, publish the two posts, and replace the submission placeholders with real links.

remaining.title: Registration, credit-claim email and final form status are not repository facts
remaining.action: Verify these in the organizer account; submit before November 26, 11:59 PM IST.

remaining.title: Kane 0.10.8 had two native-worker SIGBUS crashes with four workers
remaining.action: Use --parallel 1 if this recurs. Serial replay passed; the underlying native crash is not established or fixed here.

remaining.title: A real passing assertion may still test the wrong meaning
remaining.action: Keep the human/agent review of each claim, flow and screenshot. This is assisted verification, not an autonomous semantic oracle.

remaining.title: Cross-platform, fresh OAuth and marketplace installation were not executed
remaining.action: CI for Node 22/24 is prepared but has not run on GitHub. Windows, mobile devices and fresh-account onboarding remain untested.

remaining.title: Claude plugin validation passes with a missing-listing-icon warning
remaining.action: Add a listing icon before submitting to a plugin directory; direct local plugin use is valid.

assessment.why: Clean package runs on Node 20/22 and real browser flows pass; public release is pending.
Same flow hash passes on the fixed local build and fails on the broken deployment; eight deliberate evidence mutations are caught.
Recorded agent repair, unchanged-flow proof, policy gate and stop/guard hooks; semantic interpretation still needs review.
Working three-minute film and mobile demo, but private/default-branch release and submission links block the first-user experience.

eligibility: Not ready to place until the submission blockers are completed.

upstreamFailure.symptom: Two native v16-runner workers exited before ready with SIGBUS
upstreamFailure.cause: Not established; do not label a product defect

sources.title: Official KaneCLI hackathon rules and extended deadline

video.presentation: Edited reconstruction of recorded evidence, explicitly labelled
